name: CSS Flexbox Generator
description: Build and preview CSS Flexbox layouts and copy the resulting CSS.
search_intent: Visually configure flex-direction, justify-content, align-items, gap and wrapping and generate CSS Flexbox code.
calculation: Create a live Flexbox preview and deterministic CSS output from the selected flex-direction, justify-content, align-items, flex-wrap and gap values. Generated code should include display: flex and only valid CSS values. Provide copy functionality.
limitations: The generator focuses on common Flexbox container properties.
Complex child-specific flex-grow, flex-shrink and flex-basis rules may require manual CSS.
Preview dimensions may differ from the user's production layout.
